snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Collect the keys to your new home base and dive into the grime, exploring all Caldera County has to offer on October 23rd!

Coming to Steam, Epic Games, Xbox Series X|S, Windows Store, PlayStation 5 | 5 Pro & Nintendo Switch 2!

PowerWash Simulator 2 is available to wishlist now! https://www.bit.ly/PWS2Steam

For more pressure washing goodness, subscribe to our channel! ⤵️

Follow our Twitter for daily satisfying content: https://bit.ly/TwitterPWS
Join the conversation on our Discord: https://discord.gg/powerwashsimulator
Follow us on TikTok for quick-spray socials: https://bit.ly/PWSTikTok
